subject.title: feat(gateway): land remaining durable-approvals stack and repair main gates

question: Should retained plugin timeoutBehavior:"allow" continue during a deprecation window, or should unresolved approvals fail closed immediately?
rationale: Immediate fail-closed behavior strengthens authorization safety, but the field remains in the shipped public plugin API and existing plugins can break on upgrade; code review cannot choose that compatibility-versus-security boundary.

options.title: Honor through deprecation
options.body: Preserve allow-on-timeout for one named release train with warnings, removal timing, and focused compatibility tests.

options.title: Immediate fail closed
options.body: Approve the breaking security cutover now with upgrade communication and real affected-workflow proof.

recommendation.title: Honor through deprecation
recommendation.body: Preserve allow-on-timeout for one named release train with warnings, removal timing, and focused compatibility tests.
